# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Quick answer:** For most people, I'd pick the **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**. If you have an iPhone 16 or 17 and want 25 W charging, the **ESR CryoBoost** is the best value.

## Top picks

**1. Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand: best overall (about $80–$109)**
WIRED's top pick after testing more than 30 models. It's a chrome "tree" design that holds your iPhone and Watch in the air, with the AirPods pad on the base.
- iPhone charging: 15 W.
- Apple Watch: fast charging on Series 7 and newer.
- Phone pad: tilts, and works in landscape for StandBy mode.
- In the box: 36 W adapter. Warranty: 2 years.
- WIRED listed it at $98 from Belkin, $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- Review: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**2. ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1, Qi2.2 25 W: best value for fast charging (about $82 with a code)**
- iPhone charging: 25 W, with a cooling fan that has an off switch for quiet nights.
- Apple Watch: fast charging.
- In the box: 50 W adapter.
- WIRED and Macworld reviewed the foldable CryoBoost. The plastic build doesn't feel premium, and it sits fairly low.
- Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand. This listing shows $99.99, or about $82 with code **PARTNER18**, which it says was tested on 10/23. It's an affiliate link, and the store's checkout price is what counts.
- Reviews: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/ and https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html

**3. ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station: best budget pick (about $40)**
- iPhone charging: 15 W, on a compact stand.
- Apple Watch puck: detachable, so you can take it when traveling.
- In the box: adapter and cable.
- WIRED listed it at $40 on Amazon, down from $80.
- Review: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**4. Nomad Stand One Max: premium and fastest ($169)**
- iPhone charging: 25 W. Apple Watch: fast charging.
- Design: a heavy, glossy black base.
- No power adapter is included. You'll need a 40 W one; Nomad's sells for $25.
- Review: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**5. Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25 W: best for a desk ($130)**
- iPhone charging: 25 W.
- Height: lifts the iPhone more than 70 mm, the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand in its class.
- In the box: 45 W adapter, plus UK and EU plugs.
- Review: https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html

## Is 25 W worth paying for?

Only if both of these apply:
- **Your iPhone supports it.** The iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus get 25 W. Some other iPhone 16 models get about 20 W. iPhone 15 and older top out at 15 W.
- **You charge in short bursts.** If you mostly charge overnight, WIRED says 25 W makes little difference, so a 15 W stand like the Belkin or the budget ESR is fine.

For AirPods, check that your case supports wireless charging.

I don't have direct store links for the Belkin, Nomad or Satechi stands, so look them up by name at Amazon, Best Buy or the brand's own site. Prices change often.
